## Perf gate: FAIL (hk, eza, aube)

**Failed checks**

- aube: contention warm: paired timing regression

| Cold | 56.7 s | 57.4 s | +1.2% | 55.7 s | 56.1 s | +0.7% | 96.4 s | 101 s | +4.7% |
| Warm, same path | 1.71 s | 1.80 s | +4.8% | 0.69 s | 0.68 s | +3.4% | 3.97 s | 4.84 s | +18.7% |

| Contention, cold | 88.7 s | 89.2 s | -0.2% | 50.3 s | 50.9 s | +0.3% | 240 s | 241 s | -0.5% |
| Contention, warm | 9.06 s | 9.22 s | +3.1% | 3.72 s | 3.98 s | +9.5% | 25.6 s | 28.2 s | **+8.5% regression** |

Times are medians; positive changes are slower. A change is marked only when it clears the paired test below, so builds with fewer than 5 pairs stay inconclusive.

Versions: head `kache 1.0.0`, base `kache 1.0.0`, mbx `mbx 1.23.0`.
